reference: She has been working on this old bike since the spring.
sk: Na tej starej motorke robí od jari.
cz: Na té staré motorce dělá od jara.
acceptable: {She|He} has been working on {this|that|the} old {bike|motorbike|motorcycle} since {the spring|spring}.
Since {the spring|spring}, {she|he} has been working on {this|that|the} old {bike|motorbike|motorcycle}.

mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadruje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been working“, nie „works“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadřuje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been working“, ne „works“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action that started in the past and is still going on needs Present Perfect Continuous: “has been working”, not “works”.

mistakes.text: She is working on {this|that} old {bike|motorbike} since {the |}spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadruje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been working“, nie „is working“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadřuje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been working“, ne „is working“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action that started in the past and is still going on needs Present Perfect Continuous: “has been working”, not “is working”.

mistakes.text: She has been working on {this|that} old {bike|motorbike} from {the |}spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri začiatku obdobia s Present Perfect Continuous patrí „since“, nie „from“: „since spring“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Se začátkem období u Present Perfect Continuous patří „since“, ne „from“: „since spring“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For the starting point with Present Perfect Continuous, use “since”, not “from”: “since spring”.

mistakes.text: She has worked on {this|that} old {bike|motorbike} since {the |}spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri dlhom deji, ktorý stále prebieha, je prirodzenejší Present Perfect Continuous: „has been working“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U dlouhého děje, který pořád probíhá, je přirozenější Present Perfect Continuous: „has been working“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For a long action that is still going on, Present Perfect Continuous is more natural: “has been working”.

mistakes.text: She was working on {this|that} old {bike|motorbike} since {the |}spring.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Dej, ktorý začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadruje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been working“, nie „was working“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Děj, který začal v minulosti a trvá dodnes, vyjadřuje Present Perfect Continuous: „has been working“, ne „was working“.
mistakes.feedback_en: An action that started in the past and is still going on needs Present Perfect Continuous: “has been working”, not “was working”.

source_issues: SK/CZ 'motorka' is a motorbike; 'bike' accepted as in the reference, plus 'motorbike/motorcycle'. SK/CZ 'tej/té' = that.
